title: INT8/FP16 embedding anchor sampling and similarity quarantine
creator: Diego Ramos
description: Goal: Define an operational calibration and validation workflow that creates robust INT8/FP16 quantization profiles for our embedding models and a runtime similarity-quarantine mechanism that isolates suspect cohorts when cosine-similarity degradation is detected. This ticket covers sampling strategy for anchors, calibration dataset composition, evaluation thresholds, automated quarantine gating, and documentation for SRE/ops handoff. This work is complementary to prior calibration efforts but focuses on operationalizing per-corpus sampling and a lightweight quarantine action before rolling back primary profiles.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A reproducible calibration pipeline produces INT8 and FP16 profiles for the target embedding model with documented config/seed. 2) Validation harness runs on held-out corpora and reports cosine-similarity retention metrics; median retention >= 0.995 and 95th-percentile drop <= 0.01 for representative corpora. 3) Runtime quarantine rule implemented: if a cohort shows average cosine similarity drop > 0.02 over a 1,000-sample sliding window, requests for that cohort are routed to fallback FP16 profile and an ops alert is created. 4) Playbook documenting steps for ops to investigate and remediate runs in Confluence. 5) Unit+integration tests and a canary rollout (10% traffic) executed with metrics dashboard and runbook links.
steps: 1) Define anchor-sampling strategy: stratified sampling across known corpora, tail-heavy buckets, and recent user traffic slices. 2) Build calibration artifact generator: tokenization, embedding pre-processing, and per-layer activation capture. 3) Run quantization backend (INT8/FP16) with deterministic seeds and record scale tables and per-layer stats. 4) Evaluate on held-out sets: compute cosine similarity distribution, per-bucket deltas, and summary metrics. 5) Tune quantization hyperparams (clip thresholds, per-channel vs per-tensor) and re-run until acceptance criteria met. 6) Implement runtime detector that tracks cohort-level cosine similarity using cached anchors and emits quarantine signal + traffic reroute policy. 7) Integrate alerts, dashboards, and runbook. 8) Execute canary and collect stability telemetry for 72h before full rollout.
test_plan: - Calibration job reproducibility: run N=3 independent runs, ensure profile diffs within tolerance. - Hold-out evaluation: run against 5 corpora (news, support tickets, ecom titles, code snippets, internal docs) and compute median/95th metrics. - Synthetic drift injection: perturb embeddings with Gaussian noise (sigma up to 0.02) to validate quarantine sensitivity. - Canary smoke: 10% traffic routed to new profiles and monitor latency, error rate, and similarity metrics. - Post-deploy: scheduled nightly drift-check and weekly profile audit. All tests must be automated in CI and results stored in S3 for traceability.
